description: This file defines the main shell widget for the application's home screen, managing tab navigation, app bar display, and a floating action button to add new recipes.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: Main widget providing tab navigation and hosting the application's primary sections after login.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class managing current tab index, handling tab switching, and building the UI scaffold.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeShell widget.

methods.name: _onTab
methods.description: Updates the current tab index in response to user taps on the bottom navigation items.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI scaffold with an app bar, tab content, floating action button, and bottom navigation bar.
